hard_deny: Never read, print or send credentials: environment variables holding tokens or keys (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN), any .env file, .credentials.json or /proc/*/environ. This includes sending them in a Telegram reply, a file, a URL or a request to any host.

hooks.command: jq -rs --argjson now "$(date +%s)" '[.[] | select(.at > $now - 86400)] | .[-5:] | if length > 0 then "For context: you already sent these through scheduled jobs in the last 24 hours. Do not resend them; the owner may be referring to one.\n" + (map("- \(.at | strflocaltime("%H:%M")) [\(.name)] \(.text[0:400])") | join("\n")) else empty end' /data/workspace/sent.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true

date '+The current date and time is %A %Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z.'; jq -r 'select(.ok) | .result | "You are the Telegram bot @\(.username) (shown as \(.first_name)), id \(.id). Answer to that name."' /data/config/channels/telegram/me.json 2>/dev/null || true
jq -c '{at: (now | todate), event: .hook_event_name, tool: .tool_name, mode: .permission_mode, error: ((.error // .reason // "") | tostring | .[0:200])}' >> /data/audit.jsonl
notify.sh "⚠️ Agent stopped: $(jq -r .error). Check the credential."
notify.sh "⏸ Agent is waiting for a permission: $(jq -r .message)"
jq -c '{at: (now | todate), event: .hook_event_name, tool: .tool_name, mode: .permission_mode, error: ((.error // .reason // "") | tostring | .[0:200])}' >> /data/audit.jsonl
